title: Wordle was built as a gift for one person.
description:
Wordle was built as a gift for one person. Josh Wardle made it in January 2021 for his partner, Palak Shah.

She cut about 12,000 words down to roughly 2,500. Shah kept the commonly known ones so the daily puzzle felt fair.

Roughly how many played on 1 November 2021. It passed 300,000 by 2 January 2022.

The shareable emoji squares came from friends in New Zealand. Wardle added the format, and results spread across Twitter.

He never wanted it to be a full-time job. The game had no adverts, and Wardle has said making money was not the goal.

The New York Times bought it in January 2022 for a low seven figure sum.

Sources:
- https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Josh_Wardle - Wikipedia; established that Wardle developed Wordle in January 2021 for his partner Palak Shah, that she narrowed roughly 12,000 five-letter words to about 2,500 familiar ones, that the first working title was Mr. Bugs' Wordy Nugz (citing The Verge), that there were no adverts and he did not want it to become a full-time job, and the earlier Reddit projects The Button and r/place.
- https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wordle - Wikipedia; established approximately 90 players on 1 November 2021, over 300,000 by 2 January 2022, the emoji results grid inspired by friends in New Zealand, and the sale to The New York Times Company on 31 January 2022 for an undisclosed price in the low seven figures.
